versions.changelog:
Initial release of the "质量成熟度QMM" skill for enterprise quality management maturity assessment:

- Provides a 1–5 level maturity diagnosis framework based on ISO 9004 & EFQM logic.
- Supports 6-dimension quantitative scoring, identifying strengths and improvement priorities.
- Generates phased improvement roadmaps and dual-format (MD + HTML) reports.
- Clearly defines skill boundaries: consultative framework only, not an official replacement for executive decision.
- Includes linkage instructions for related management audit and review skills.
